text: The 'Assessment of Government Drought Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Myanmar (2020–2025)' is a composite evaluation of Myanmar's efforts to reduce and mitigate drought risks during the specified period. It synthesizes actions documented under various national and regional frameworks, including the Myanmar Action Plan on Disaster Risk Reduction (MAPDRR), the updated Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), and ASEAN's AADMER Work Programme. The assessment highlights improvements in technical capacity for drought monitoring and policy intent, but notes constraints in sustained mitigation financing and local implementation.
